purpose: Test whether prior offensive snap participation adds independent preseason projection signal beyond the current Native V2 and the newly validated WR/TE role-opportunity bundle.

source.upstream: Pro Football Reference snap counts served through nflverse
source.join: PFR player id to nflverse players pfr_id/gsis_id mapping

base_policy.QB: current Native V2 QB feature bundle; rejected role/opportunity share features remain excluded
base_policy.RB: current Native V2 RB feature bundle; rejected role/opportunity share features remain excluded
base_policy.WR: current Native V2 plus retained provisional WR target-share/vacated-opportunity/role interaction bundle
base_policy.TE: current Native V2 plus retained provisional TE target-share/vacated-opportunity/role interaction bundle

anti_double_counting: Every snap challenger is evaluated on top of the currently accepted/provisional position-specific base. A snap feature must improve that stronger base; it does not receive credit for reproducing already retained opening-role or target-share information.

allowed: completed prior-season offensive snap counts and snap percentages
target-season opening role information already admitted by the Native V2 challenger architecture
forbidden: target-season realized snaps or snap percentage
target-season realized routes, targets, carries, attempts, team totals or injuries
external projection values as Native training labels

validation.retention_gate: At least +0.5 percentage points mean improvement versus the stronger position-specific base and improvement in at least 3 of 4 holdouts.
validation.external_followup: Any retained snap formulation must subsequently be tested on the exact independent external common cohort without re-selecting the formulation on that external data.
